title: Understanding Revelation: Babylon = Jerusalem
theme: A legacy essay argues that Revelation’s symbolic Babylon represents first-century Jerusalem and its judgment.
proposition: In this paper I will show you that this “Babylon” is a symbolic reference to Jerusalem as it existed prior to AD 70.
sermonQuestion: What evidence does the essay give for identifying Revelation’s Babylon with first-century Jerusalem?

legacyImport.contentPreservation: Original Josh Hetrick legacy sermon preserved unchanged.
